extraction.Name: Henry Jacobs
extraction.Recorded patent: Pat recorded for N/2. 19. Feb 13th 1920; filed for record vol 169 page 214
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged and sold; North half was sold, and the south is still held by Anderson of Pierre S.D.; S/2 of Sec 18-108-74 mortgaged to the Farmers State Bank of Canning S.D. for $2000.00 at 8% int., recorded in vol 150, page 959, Feb 20th 1920; N/2 of Section 19-108-74 mortgaged to Flora B. Anderson of Hughs County for $2000.00 with interest at 9%, filed for record in vol 164 page 195, June 18th 1920
extraction.Buyer: N/2 foreclosed and sold by sheriff Oct 8th 1921 for $2201.85 (principal and int. $2145.00, att'y fees $25.00, printers fees $16.25, sheriff fees $10.60, recorders fees $5.00); S/2 foreclosed and sold at sheriff sale April 4th 1925 for $2813.46 (principal and interest $2658.61, att'y fees $25.00, publishers fees $13.00, sheriff fees $10.00, recorders fees $5.00, taxes paid by mortgagor $1101.25); Anderson of Pierre S.D. holds south half
extraction.NOTES: Jacobs wife never signed one mortgage of the half that was mortgaged to Summerville; records at the Court House at Pierre S.D., Hughes County; S/2 of Sec 18-108-74 and N/2 of Section 19-108-74, Township 108, Range 74; document prepared by Geo H.
